ordering_rule: phase fixed partial order -> before/after DAG -> order -> stable identity; same phase and order without declared relation is a tie and rejected; cycle rejected
selection_rule: each selection group resolves to exactly one active variant in the plan; zero or multiple active variants are rejected; group-external plugins remain active
hash_rule: plan hash = sha256 of canonical plan body; Cordis graph hash, compiled Manifest plan hash, and Rust loaded plan hash must match; mismatch fails publish or execute
single_plan_rule: a node compiles exactly one immutable NodePluginPlan; the legacy single-operator + separate-hooks model is not publishable
